stories.title: Exigen en Madrid fin de la crisis de vivienda; expresan solidaridad con Maricarmen Abascal, mujer de 87 años desalojada

en.title: Madrid demands end to housing crisis; express solidarity with Maricarmen Abascal, 87-year-old woman evicted
en.summary: Demonstrations in Madrid called for resolution of the housing crisis while supporting an elderly woman facing eviction. The Spanish government indicated it would present an initiative on the matter.

stories.title: Esteban Solari queda bajo presión: Pumas pierde 3-2 ante Atlético de San Luis

en.title: Esteban Solari under pressure: Pumas lose 3-2 to Atlético de San Luis
en.summary: Pumas suffered their fourth loss of the Apertura 2026 tournament, finishing with 12 points after a defeat against Atlético de San Luis.

stories.title: Pumas continúa en caída libre; sufre derrota ante el Atlético San Luis

en.title: Pumas continues in free fall; suffers defeat against Atlético San Luis
en.summary: Pumas lost 2-3 to Atlético San Luis and remain in a difficult streak without achieving results in their current crisis.

stories.title: Papa León XIV reconoce carácter “sistémico” de abusos sexuales en Iglesia francesa, afirma víctima

en.title: Pope Leo XIV recognizes "systemic" nature of sexual abuse in French Church, victim states
en.summary: The Pope met with seven abuse victims in Lourdes for nearly two hours and committed to taking measures to prevent future abuse in the French Church.

stories.title: Tormenta deja a miles de hogares sin electricidad en el noreste de EU; persisten las lluvias intensas

en.title: Storm leaves thousands of homes without electricity in northeastern US; intense rains persist
en.summary: Over 130,000 customers lost power in the northeastern and mid-Atlantic regions on Sunday morning due to a storm with continued heavy rainfall.

stories.title: Papa León XIV pide el fin de la "lacra de los abusos" en la Iglesia católica; se reúne con 7 víctimas

en.title: Pope Leo XIV calls for end to "scourge of abuse" in Catholic Church; meets with 7 victims
en.summary: During a visit to France, the Pope urged bishops to maintain vigilance against abuse in the Church and met with seven victims of misconduct.

stories.title: Trump afirma que detenidos cerca de base aérea de EU pretendían causar “grandes daños”

en.title: Trump states that detainees near US air base intended to cause "major damage"
en.summary: Five men remain detained as suspects in preparing a terrorist act, with bomb experts inspecting three vans and evacuating 85 homes near the base.

stories.title: Pumas (2-3) Atlético San Luis EN VIVO; sigue aquí el minuto a minuto del partido

en.title: Pumas (2-3) vs Atlético San Luis LIVE; follow the minute-by-minute of the match
en.summary: Pumas plays Atlético San Luis at the Olympic Stadium in a crucial match for their chances of qualifying for the playoff tournament.

stories.title: Pandas vuelven a Atlanta tras acuerdo entre Trump y Xi; Ping Ping y Fu Shuang llegan desde China por 10 años

en.title: Pandas return to Atlanta following agreement between Trump and Xi; Ping Ping and Fu Shuang arrive from China for 10 years
en.summary: Two giant pandas have arrived in Atlanta from China as part of a diplomatic agreement. China uses panda loans to other countries as a cultural projection and indicator of diplomatic relations.

stories.title: Arrestan a 5 hombres por sospecha de terrorismo cerca de base británica de Fairford, usada por EU; Trump elogia actuación de autoridades

en.title: 5 men arrested on suspicion of terrorism near British Fairford base used by US; Trump praises authorities' response
en.summary: Five individuals were arrested near the Fairford military base in the UK on terrorism suspicions. The base, used by the US under a Cold War-era agreement, was reportedly permitted for operations against Iranian missile sites.

stories.title: Tormenta en el noreste de EU deja un muerto y miles de cortes de luz

en.title: Storm in northeastern US leaves one dead and thousands without power
en.summary: A severe storm in the northeastern United States resulted in one fatality and widespread power outages. The storm is expected to weaken and move eastward, with heavy rainfall continuing in New York and New England.

stories.title: ¿Quiénes son Ping Ping y Fu Shuang? Los pandas que China envía por 10 años a EU

en.title: Who are Ping Ping and Fu Shuang? The pandas China sends to US for 10 years
en.summary: Two giant pandas departed from Chengdu and arrived in Atlanta, where they will remain for a decade. The animals are part of China's panda diplomacy program.

stories.title: EU y China abrirán un "canal de comunicación" sobre la inteligencia artificial

en.title: US and China will open a "communication channel" on artificial intelligence
en.summary: The US and China confirmed they will meet for the third and fourth times this year, with their next meeting scheduled for the APEC summit in Shenzhen in November.

stories.title: Bangkok, capital de Tailandia, declara estado de desastre tras casi 48 horas de lluvias torrenciales

en.title: Bangkok, capital of Thailand, declares disaster state after nearly 48 hours of torrential rains
en.summary: Bangkok has declared a disaster state following intense rainfall that caused canal overflow and forced the closure of 13 roads due to flooding.

stories.title: Tupperware encara el reto de llegar a nuevas generaciones con sus tradicionales ventas por catálogo

en.title: Tupperware faces challenge of reaching new generations with its traditional catalog sales
en.summary: Tupperware, which previously aimed to expand into physical retail spaces like supermarkets, is adjusting its strategy following its bankruptcy restructuring process.

stories.title: México envejeció en cinco años y la presión por pagar pensiones apenas comienza

en.title: Mexico aged in five years and pressure to pay pensions is just beginning
en.summary: Mexico's population has aged significantly, with one in six households already receiving pensions. Public spending on pensions is projected to reach 2.5 trillion pesos by 2027.

stories.title: Trump rechaza el plan iraní para reabrir el estrecho de Ormuz

en.title: Trump rejects Iranian plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz
en.summary: Iran proposed reopening the Strait of Hormuz within seven days following approval of an agreement, but Trump rejected the proposal.
